newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Sentrachem results now due Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Sentrachem results now due Thursday.

text.p: Half year results from South African chemicals group Sentrachem Ltd will be released on Thursday, instead of Wednesday as originally expected.
"The board meeting is going on a little longer than expected," a company spokeswoman said.

Analysts polled by Reuters forecast Sentrachem's earnings for the six months ended February 28 sliding into loss, ranging between 60.0 and 80.0 cents a share with consensus at 68.3 cents versus 55 cents profit in the same period last year.
The company was not expected to declare a dividend in the interim period.
